question: Who has been appointed as the Chief Justice of India with effect from May 14, 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shri Justice Bhushan Ramkrishna Gavai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shri Justice Bhushan Ramkrishna Gavai** has been appointed as the **Chief Justice of India (CJI)** with effect from **May 14, 2025**. He is set to be the **53rd Chief Justice of India**.
 
• Justice Gavai was appointed as a judge of the **Supreme Court of India** on **May 24, 2019**. His tenure in the judiciary has been marked by significant contributions and judgments.
 
• He will succeed the current CJI as per the seniority norms traditionally followed in the appointment process of Chief Justices in India.
 
• Shri Justice Bhushan Ramkrishna Gavai hails from the state of **Maharashtra**, and he is known for his expertise in constitutional, civil, and criminal law matters.
 
• His appointment reflects the continuation of the seniority convention in the Indian judiciary, ensuring a smooth transition in the office of the Chief Justice of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Role of the Chief Justice of India (CJI):**

 
 
• The **CJI** is the head of the **judiciary system of India** and the **Supreme Court**, which is the highest judicial forum and final court of appeal under the Constitution of India.
 
• The CJI plays a pivotal role in ensuring the independence and integrity of the judiciary.
 
• The CJI is also responsible for the allocation of cases and appointment of constitutional benches to deal with significant legal issues.
 
 
 
• **Appointment Process:**
 
 
• The appointment of the CJI is based on the convention of seniority, where the senior-most judge of the Supreme Court is appointed as the CJI.
 
• The **President of India** appoints the CJI under Article 124(2) of the **Indian Constitution**.
 
• The recommendation for appointment is made by the outgoing CJI.
 
 
 
• **Notable Judgments by Justice Bhushan Ramkrishna Gavai:**
 
 
• Justice Gavai has delivered judgments on various key issues, including constitutional law, human rights, and environmental law.
 
• He has contributed significantly to cases relating to **administrative law** and **judicial review** of executive actions.
 
 
 
• **Important Facts About the Supreme Court:**
 
 
• The Supreme Court of India was established on **January 28, 1950**, after the adoption of the Constitution of India.
 
• The Supreme Court comprises the **CJI** and a maximum of **34 judges** (as per the current sanctioned strength).
 
• It functions as the **guardian of the Constitution** and is vested with the power of **judicial review**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The tenure of a Chief Justice of India is not fixed but depends on the retirement age of **65 years**, as prescribed under the Constitution.
 
• Justice Gavai will hold office as the CJI for a short period, as his retirement is due on **November 24, 2025**.
 
• The Supreme Court plays a crucial role in maintaining the balance of power between the legislature, executive, and judiciary, as enshrined in the Constitution of India.
